name: wiro-ai
description: Find the right image, video, audio or LLM model on Wiro AI, check its price and run it without leaving Devin
shortDescription: Run AI image, video and audio models

setup.notice: Devin opens the Wiro sign-in page the first time it connects. Sign in, pick the project whose wallet pays for runs and click Allow.
steps: Sign up at wiro.ai if you don't have an account yet
When Devin opens the Wiro sign-in page, sign in, pick a project and click Allow
